items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Well, some of the key men, like Sonny Cohn, he's with Basie, I brought him in at that particular time

ctx.x: Who were some of your key men?

Well, some of the key men, like Sonny Cohn, he's with Basie, I brought him in at that particular time, and then I had Earl Washington, well, he was a former brother-in-law of mine, and --on piano, and I had the boy now who's with the Trendiers, Walter Cole, he was on bass. And on saxes, we had Porter Kilbert. Did you ever know Porter?
I didn't know him, but I've heard him play.
